decision: Define Stage-0 with a true native numeric-JSON zero-shot arm and a separate zero-step codec-initialized arm that exactly matches the Stage-1 grammar.
rationale: New loc tokens cannot be emitted meaningfully by an unmodified native Qwen model. Calling that identical-grammar result native zero-shot would be false. Replacing Stage-1 loc tokens with native numeric JSON would increase one-person output to 693 tokens and a 19-person output to 13,095 tokens. Two Stage-0 arms preserve both truthful native capability and a strict pre-tuning control.
reopen_condition: Changing the Stage-1 loc-token grammar or merging the two Stage-0 arms requires a new protocol decision before predictions are generated.
